primary_question: Does a jointly normalized six-property condition improve support-aware controllability over scalar conductivity conditioning, binary conductivity control, and unconditional generation plus frozen-surrogate reranking on matched interpolation targets?
primary_estimand: paired seed-by-target-cell difference in joint strict-hit rate for multi_continuous versus scalar_continuous, with binary_conductivity and unconditional_reranking as prespecified controls
interpretation_boundary: Prediction-only evidence under the released HTP-MD representation, frozen train-only transforms/scalers, Morgan-fingerprint RF verifiers, and PolyGen gpt-nano sampling; no MD or experimental claim.

source.split: same stratified conductivity-decile train/test split as the historical interpolation benchmark
source.hash_policy: sha256 recorded in source_audit.json and frozen_manifest.json

target_construction.marginal_probes: For each property and Q50/Q65/Q80, replace only that property's train empirical quantile and retain the other five coordinates at their train medians; each vector is audited in the fitted train-only joint support model.
target_construction.coherent_joint_targets: Three deterministic vectors selected from train-only empirical-copula rows at Q50/Q65/Q80 of the row-wise mean marginal percentile score. This preserves observed cross-property dependence and is not an independent quantile Cartesian product.
target_construction.forbidden: Independent Cartesian products of six marginal quantiles are not generated or treated as joint targets.

arms.multi_continuous: six-dimensional train-only normalized condition vector through one learned prefix embedding
arms.scalar_continuous: historical scalar conductivity continuous prefix; only the target log10 conductivity is passed
arms.binary_conductivity: historical fixed high/low conductivity interface; only the binary label is passed and the target vector is never passed
arms.unconditional_reranking: constant-zero condition generator with a frozen, separate six-property RF reranking step; target information enters only after generation

pairing.unit: seed x arm x target cell

md_policy: MD is explicitly not run in this prediction phase. Any candidate table is a proposed review table only.
historical_results_policy: Do not modify sources/ or results/interpolation, results/upper-tail, or results/extrapolation. All outputs belong under results/multi-property/interpolation/.
